_doc: Project anchor for this design system's Figma integration. Single source of truth for which Figma file we read from. Maps in maps/*.json resolve their `source` keys against this file. Never hard-code a file key in a script or a skill — read it from here, so pointing the system at a different file is one edit.

bridges._doc: TWO bridges, recorded separately. Nothing in `pnpm verify` or CI depends on either, so the repo is green on a machine with no Figma tooling installed. Code stays canonical for token values in both directions; a difference is drift in Figma, never a change to adopt back.

read._doc: The official Figma MCP connector. No daemon, no plugin, no Figma Desktop.

write._doc: figma-console MCP driving the Desktop Bridge plugin. OPT-IN and unwired: no script, gate or skill in this repo invokes it. Every write must first compare `figma.fileKey` against sources.<key>.key and pin the target with `figma_navigate({ url, lock: true })`.
requires: Desktop Bridge plugin open in the target file

main._doc: NOT LINKED YET. `key: null` records that no design file has been chosen — fill key, name and url when one is. The source key `main` is what maps/*.json point at.
main.purpose: The design source for this system.

identity._doc: The package scope and the CSS / data-attribute prefixes live in /ds.config.json and are not repeated here.

variableNaming._doc: How a Figma variable name maps to a token. NOT MEASURED: no file is linked and no token system exists. Fill from a live read, never from an assumption.

variableCollections._doc: Figma collection -> canonical token source file under packages/tokens/. EMPTY: filled by hand from a live read, once the token set is decided. A Figma variable whose collection has no entry here resolves to `code: null` in maps/tokens.json and is reported as drift.

codePathConvention._doc: Where a Figma component's code counterpart lives. UNDECIDED until packages/react has a folder layout.
